<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 13"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Phantom Charm](/Feats.aspx?ID=5379) <actions string="Free Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Divine" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=579" />
<trait label="Fortune" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=612" />
<trait label="Minotaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=788" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 45

**Frequency**
once per day

**Prerequisites**
[Ghost Bull Minotaur](/Heritages.aspx?ID=303) heritage

**Trigger**
You attempt a check that would be subject to a [misfortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=654) effect.

</column>

---

You can harness the spiritual connection in your blood, allowing you to shift the negative threads of fate. You negate the misfortune effect and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the triggering check.
name: Phantom Charm
